requirement: GET a JSON object from an HTTP API with aiohttp, sending query params and an Accept header, and turn error statuses, non-JSON responses and non-object bodies into one typed ApiError with a bounded message.
skeleton: An ApiError exception carrying status and message, a MAX_ERROR_CHARS limit, and fetch_json checking status, content type and body shape inside the response context.
caption: A typed JSON fetch helper with aiohttp. ApiError(status, message) stores both and formats as status: message. fetch_json(session, url, *, params=None) opens session.get with the params and an Accept application/json header inside async with, so the response is always released. A status of 400 or more raises ApiError with the status and the body text cut to MAX_ERROR_CHARS, 200. A content_type other than application/json raises ApiError saying expected JSON, got that type before resp.json is ever called. A JSON body that is not an object raises ApiError saying expected a JSON object; otherwise the dict is returned. The fixture runs an aiohttp TestServer and asserts that params and the Accept header reach the handler, that a 400 carries status 400 and the body bad input, that a 503 with 300 characters is cut to 200 and formats as 503: x..., that a text/html page raises ApiError naming it, and that a JSON array raises ApiError.

plan.intent: Call a JSON API and give callers one error type to handle
constraints: Params and Accept application/json are sent with the GET
Statuses of 400 and above raise ApiError with the body cut to 200 characters
Non-JSON content types raise ApiError before decoding
Bodies that are not JSON objects raise ApiError
The response is released through async with

rationale.teaches: Check status and content type before decoding, keep error bodies bounded, and validate the decoded shape before returning it.
rationale.why: Treating 4xx as success, letting decoder errors escape, or returning whatever JSON arrived pushes protocol errors deep into callers.

ops.docstring: Fetch a JSON object over HTTP with aiohttp and typed API errors.

candidates.why_wrong: Only 5xx statuses are errors, so a 400 body is treated as a success.
HTML responses reach resp.json and fail with an aiohttp decoding error.
The query params are never sent with the request.
A JSON array is returned where callers expect an object.
Error bodies are kept up to 2000 characters instead of 200.
